q: What is the SI unit of force?
exp: Force is measured in Newtons (N). One Newton is the force needed to accelerate 1kg mass at 1m/s².

q: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
exp: Velocity has both magnitude and direction, making it a vector quantity.

q: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately...
exp: Light travels at approximately 3 × 10⁸ meters per second in vacuum.

q: Which instrument is used to measure electric current?
exp: An ammeter measures electric current in amperes.

q: The unit of electrical resistance is...

exp: Sound travels fastest in solids because particles are closer together.

q: The SI unit of power is...
exp: Power is measured in Watts (W), equal to one Joule per second.

q: Which law states that energy cannot be created or destroyed?
exp: The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy can only be transformed, not created or destroyed.

q: The acceleration due to gravity on Earth is approximately...
exp: Gravity on Earth accelerates objects at approximately 9.8 m/s².

q: Which of the following is NOT a form of energy?
exp: Friction is a force, not a form of energy.

q: Which color of light has the shortest wavelength?
exp: Violet has the shortest wavelength in the visible spectrum.
